bug_report_content: JFreeChart / Bugs / #834 Bug propgated from v1.0.5 on to present Join/Login Business Software Open Source Software For Vendors Blog About More Articles Create SourceForge Podcast Site Documentation Subscribe to our Newsletter Support Request Bug propgated from v1.0.5 on to present Brought to you by: mungady , taqua This project can now be found here. Summary Files Reviews Support Mailing Lists Tickets ▾ Patches Bugs Feature Requests News Code Cvs Menu ▾ ▴ Create Ticket View Stats Group 1.0.x Searches Changes Closed Tickets Open Tickets Help Formatting Help #834 Bug propgated from v1.0.5 on to present Milestone: 1.0.x Status: closed-fixed Owner: David Gilbert Labels: General (896) Priority: 5 Updated: 2008-02-25 Created: 2008-02-20 Creator: Terry Norbraten Private: No The method getRowCount() in class org.jfree.data.category.DefaultIntervalCategoryDataset says that it "Returns the number of series in the dataset (possibly zero)." The implementation from v1.0.5 on no longer checks for a null condition (which would then return a zero) on the seriesKeys as it did in v1.0.4 and previous. This now throws a Null Pointer if seriesKeys never got initialized and the getRowCount() method is called. Discussion Terry Norbraten - 2008-02-20 Logged In: YES user_id=1097680 Originator: YES The method getColumnCount() had the same type of issue: a null condition no longer gets checked for and now throws a Null Pointer if called. If you would like to refer to this comment somewhere else in this project, copy and paste the following link: David Gilbert - 2008-02-25 assigned_to : nobody --> mungady status : open --> closed-fixed If you would like to refer to this comment somewhere else in this project, copy and paste the following link: David Gilbert - 2008-02-25 Logged In: YES user_id=112975 Originator: NO Thanks for the report. I've committed a fix to Subversion for inclusion in the 1.0.10 release.
